notes.title: Dev Log #01 - Why Astro Burn is created in the GDevelop Engine.
notes.content: [h1][b]Dev log 01[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Over the past few months, I’ve had countless friends and peers in the games industry ask me the same question — why did I choose to build Astro Burn in GDevelop instead of Unreal Engine, the tool I’ve used for most of my career?[/p][p][/p][p]In this video, I break it all down. I’ll share my reasons for switching engines, show new gameplay footage from [i]Astro Burn[/i], and give you a behind-the-scenes look at how I’m developing the game using GDevelop.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="SySQZPqwYmw;full"][/previewyoutube]
